classification.label: Classification
classification.help: Decides who may download the file, whether it may be shared by link, and whether copies carry the viewer's email.

rules.Public: Anyone may get a link, with or without an expiry.
rules.Internal: Links need an expiry date within 90 days.
rules.Confidential: Links need an expiry within 30 days, an access code and the recipient's email. Downloads carry the viewer's email and the time.
rules.Restricted: Never shared by link. Downloads need the restricted export capability and a second sign-in factor.

create.heading: New link
create.expiresHelp: The link stops opening at the end of this day. Up to {days} days ahead.
create.noExpiry: Leave empty for a link that never expires.
create.accessCodeForced: Confidential files always ask for an access code.
create.recipientHelp: Their email is printed on every page they download.
create.restricted: Restricted files are never shared by link.

created.heading: Link created
created.copyOnce: Copy the link and the code now. They are shown only once.
created.codeHelp: Send the code separately from the link.

row.opened: {count, plural, =0 {Not opened yet} one {Opened once} other {Opened # times}}

errors.share_link_restricted: Restricted files are never shared by link.
errors.share_link_confidential: Sharing a Confidential file needs the export capability for Confidential data.
errors.share_link_recipient: Enter the recipient's email. The watermark carries it.
errors.share_link_watermark_unsupported: This Confidential file cannot carry the viewer watermark, so it cannot be shared by link. Only PNG and JPEG images can.
errors.share_link_expiry_range: Choose a date after today and within the limit.
errors.share_link_file: Wait until the file has scanned clean.
errors.attachment_classification_lower: Only the person who added the file, or someone who may set classifications, can lower it.
errors.notFound: This file is no longer available.

open.title: Shared file
open.intro: Someone shared a file with you. Open it below.
open.accessCodeHelp: Enter the 6-digit code if you received one with the link.
open.watermark: Confidential images download as a PDF that shows your email and the time.

refusals.share_link_invalid: This link does not work. It may have been revoked or mistyped.
refusals.share_link_locked: This link is locked after too many wrong codes. Ask the sender for a new one.
refusals.share_link_expired: This link has expired. Ask the sender for a new one.
refusals.share_link_reclassified: This file can no longer be shared this way. Ask the sender.
refusals.share_link_access_code_required: Enter the access code that came with the link.
refusals.share_link_access_code: That code is not right. After 5 wrong codes the link locks.
refusals.share_link_rate_limited: Too many attempts from your network. Wait 10 minutes and try again.

download.download_confidential: Downloading a Confidential file needs the export capability for Confidential data.
download.download_restricted: Downloading a Restricted file needs the restricted export capability.
download.step_up_required: Downloading a Restricted file needs a second sign-in factor. Sign in again with your second factor, then try again.
